speakingRateLabels.slow: Your pace is slower than ideal. Try to speak a bit faster to maintain engagement.

hints.fillerWords: Aim for fewer than 5 per session

fillerWordLevel.low: Excellent! Minimal filler words that don't distract from your message.
fillerWordLevel.medium: Some filler words present. With practice, you can reduce them further.
fillerWordLevel.high: Many filler words that may distract from your message. Focus on pausing instead of filling silence.

voice_articulation.why: Crisp pronunciation keeps every insight clear and trustworthy.
voice_articulation.instantTip: Slow the first sentence of each idea and exaggerate consonants for those opening words.
voice_articulation.microPractice: Read the next paragraph of your script aloud while placing a fingertip beneath your chin - if your chin bounces on every syllable you're clipping words; reset and repeat.
voice_articulation.trackThis: Aim for articulation ≥ 7.5 while keeping pace steady.

presence_eye_contact.why: Eye contact is the fastest way to hold attention and signal confidence.
presence_eye_contact.instantTip: Lock eyes with the lens for the first full sentence of each new idea, then glance briefly to your notes.
presence_eye_contact.microPractice: Stick a small dot next to the lens and explain one bullet point while keeping your gaze on the dot for 3-5 seconds before looking away.
presence_eye_contact.trackThis: Hold the lens for 70% of sentences to move the score above 8.

impact_persuasiveness.why: Persuasiveness converts attention into action; it needs structured emphasis.
impact_persuasiveness.instantTip: Sum each point with a bold "so here's what that means for you..." statement.
impact_persuasiveness.microPractice: Record a 30-second pitch where every sentence ends with a clear benefit to the listener. Play it back and confirm you can hear the benefit in each line.
impact_persuasiveness.trackThis: Use benefit-driven closes on every key point until impact > 6.5.

confidence_filler_word_control.why: Filler words undermine your authority and make you sound uncertain.
confidence_filler_word_control.instantTip: Replace "um" and "uh" with a 2-second pause. Pauses sound thoughtful, not uncertain.
confidence_filler_word_control.microPractice: Record yourself speaking for 1 minute. Count your filler words, then re-record aiming for zero.
confidence_filler_word_control.trackThis: Reduce filler words to less than 2 per minute.

presence_body_posture.why: Good posture projects confidence and helps you breathe better for clearer speech.
presence_body_posture.instantTip: Stand or sit with your shoulders back, chest open, and chin parallel to the floor.
presence_body_posture.microPractice: Record yourself standing tall for 30 seconds, then watch it back to see the difference.
presence_body_posture.trackThis: Maintain upright posture throughout your entire recording.

voice_tone_variation.why: Varying your tone keeps your audience engaged and emphasizes key points.
voice_tone_variation.instantTip: Raise your pitch on important words and lower it for emphasis.
voice_tone_variation.microPractice: Read a paragraph three times: monotone, then with variation, then with extreme variation.
voice_tone_variation.trackThis: Vary your pitch by at least 3-4 notes throughout your delivery.

default.why: Sharpening this lever has the fastest payoff for your communication goal.
default.instantTip: Name the behavior you want in the very next conversation and do it on the first sentence.
default.microPractice: Record a 45-second run focused only on this cue; watch once and note the moment you nailed it.
default.trackThis: Move this metric above 7.0 and keep it there for two sessions.

improvement.confidence_filler_word_control: Your filler words decreased by {{change}} points. You're speaking with more confidence and authority. Instead of filling silence with "um" and "uh", you're pausing thoughtfully, which makes you sound more deliberate and prepared.
improvement.voice_tone_variation: Your vocal variety improved from {{first}} to {{latest}}. You're using your voice more expressively, which keeps your audience engaged. Varying your tone helps emphasize key points and prevents monotony.
improvement.presence_body_posture: Your posture improved by {{change}} points. You're standing taller and more confidently, which projects authority and self-assurance. Good posture also helps you breathe better and speak more clearly.
improvement.clarity_structure: Your message structure improved from {{first}} to {{latest}}. You're organizing your thoughts more clearly, making it easier for your audience to follow along. A well-structured message is more persuasive and memorable.
improvement.impact_energy: Your energy level increased by {{change}} points. You're bringing more enthusiasm to your delivery, which makes you more engaging and compelling. Higher energy helps you connect with your audience and keep their attention.

faqs.q1: What happens after I upload a video?
a1: Our AI analyzes your body language, voice, and delivery within 1-2 minutes.
You receive a detailed report with scores across 25+ communication parameters, plus personalized improvement tips.
We generate practice exercises tailored to your weakest areas, so you know exactly what to work on next.
faqs.q2: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faqs.a2: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime with no penalties. All your past analyses, progress data, and practice history stay in your account permanently-even after cancellation. You can always come back and pick up where you left off.
faqs.a3: Absolutely! All plans let you create separate practice journeys for different goals-like interview prep, public speaking, sales conversations, or general confidence. Each journey tracks its own progress independently, so you can see how you're improving in each area.
faqs.q4: What if I exceed my plan's monthly limit?
faqs.a4: If you use all your monthly analyses, you can either upgrade to a higher plan or purchase individual analyses at $2.50 per video. We'll notify you when you're close to your limit so you can decide what works best for you.
faqs.q5: How secure is my video data?
faqs.a5: Your privacy is our priority. Videos are encrypted in transit and at rest, stored securely, and never shared with third parties. You can delete any video or analysis at any time from your account. We use enterprise-grade security practices to protect your data.
faqs.q6: Can I try before I buy?
faqs.a6: Yes! Start with our free plan.You get 1 full analysis per month with all the same features as paid plans. This lets you experience the complete AI analysis, see your scores, and try the practice exercises before committing to a paid plan.
faqs.a7: Yes! The Unlimited plan works great for teams, and we offer custom enterprise pricing for larger organizations. Teams get shared dashboards, centralized billing, admin controls, and dedicated onboarding support. Contact us for special team pricing and setup help.
faqs.q8: How long are my videos and analyses stored?
faqs.a8: Your videos and analyses are stored indefinitely as long as your account is active. Even if you cancel your subscription, your data remains accessible. You can delete individual videos or your entire account at any time from your settings.
faqs.q9: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a9: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and debit cards. Payments are processed securely through Stripe. You can update your payment method or billing information anytime in your account settings.
